name: reviews
title: Reviews
summary: Product reviews (Verified Purchase), seller feedback kept separate from product reviews, public seller responses under rules, product questions and answers labelled by who answered, reports of inappropriate content, moderation with outcomes visible to reporter and author, appeals, and rating summaries for products and sellers.
owns: Product reviews: eligibility from a delivered purchase (Verified Purchase), rating, headline, text, photos, name display, edit and delete
Seller feedback per seller package: item as described, dispatch speed, communication, comment; shown on the seller profile, never on the product page
Public seller responses to product reviews and seller feedback, one per review, editable for a limited time, checked against rules
Product questions and answers labelled Seller, Marketly staff or Customer, with helpful votes
Helpful votes on reviews and answers
Reports of inappropriate content by customers, sellers, the system or Trust and Risk
Moderation queue and decisions with policy reasons; legitimate negative reviews are not removed
Outcomes visible to the reporter and the author; appeals reviewed by a different moderator
Rating summaries: product average and distribution; seller positive percentage over 12 months
notOwns: Reports about listings (counterfeit, misleading claims) and fake-review investigations: trust (reviews refers patterns there)
Review invitations by email: notifications (reads reviews.invite.due)
Search ranking by rating: search (reads reviews.rating.changed)

stateMachines.name: Product review
stateMachines.notes: Submit runs automatic checks (contact details, links, profanity, payment offers); passing content publishes at once, failing content is held for moderation. Reported reviews stay visible while reviewed unless the report reason is in hideOnReportReasons (e.g. personal information). keep/remove/requestEdit are moderation decisions with a policy reason, taken from pending, held or published content in one move; 'harms sales' or an unfavourable rating is never a removal reason. reinstate follows an overturned appeal or a reversed trust enforcement. Edits re-run the checks.

stateMachines.name: Seller feedback
stateMachines.notes: Eligible once the seller's package is delivered (or its delivery date has passed), within sellerFeedbackWindowDays. Feedback about the product itself can be reported as off-topic; slow service mentioned in a product review stays (honest experience). Feedback has no edit request: request_edit on feedback is refused with ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.

stateMachines.name: Question
stateMachines.notes: Questions passing the automatic checks publish at once. Removing a question removes it from the product page with its answers; reinstate follows an overturned appeal or a reversed trust enforcement.

stateMachines.name: Answer
stateMachines.notes: Answers passing the automatic checks publish at once; held ones (links, medical claims, off-platform offers) wait for review. Staff answers can require a second check (setting). A published answer can get an edit request after a report (it leaves the page until resubmitted). The author edits with PATCH /me/answers/{id} (customers) or PATCH /answers/{id} (sellers): edit from published, resubmit from edit_requested; both re-run the checks.

stateMachines.name: Seller response
stateMachines.notes: One response per review or feedback. Rule check blocks names beyond what the customer shows, addresses, order details, offers of refunds or gifts for changing feedback, links, contact details and insults. Editable until editableUntil (responseEditDays). A published response that is reported can be rejected (reject_response); reinstate follows an overturned appeal. Official Store responses follow the same machine and are written by staff.

stateMachines.name: Moderation item
stateMachines.notes: A new report on decided content within reportCooldownDays attaches to the decided item without reopening unless the reason differs; an appeal reopens it in the appeal queue.

stateMachines.name: Appeal
stateMachines.notes: Decided by a moderator other than the original one (SAME_MODERATOR). Allowed until appealBy (appealWindowDays).

consumes.name: trust.enforcement.recorded
consumes.does: remove_reviews: remove the reviews, questions and answers named in targets with a moderation decision (reason proven_fake, trust_enforcement_id recorded), tell the authors, recalculate ratings, publish reviews.moderation.decided with trustEnforcementId (trust confirms) and reviews.review.removed for reviews. keep_reviews: decide open moderation items on the named content as kept (reason legitimate_experience) so held content is published again. REVIEW_NOT_ELIGIBLE.meaning: No delivered purchase of this product by the customer, or the review window has ended.

ALREADY_REVIEWED.meaning: The customer already reviewed this product (or left feedback for this package); edit it instead. details.id.

FEEDBACK_NOT_YET_AVAILABLE.meaning: Seller feedback opens after the package is delivered. details.availableFrom.

ALREADY_REPORTED.meaning: The caller already reported this content.

RESPONSE_ALREADY_EXISTS.meaning: A seller response exists; edit it instead.

RESPONSE_EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED.meaning: The response can no longer be edited.

INVALID_REMOVAL_REASON.meaning: Removal needs a policy reason; unfavourable content or harms sales is not one.

SAME_MODERATOR.meaning: An appeal must be decided by a different moderator.

NOT_AN_OFFER_SELLER.meaning: The seller has no offer on this product or did not sell this item.

notes: Product reviews describe the item and appear on the product page for all sellers; seller feedback describes buying from a seller (as described, dispatch, communication) and appears only on the seller profile. They are separate tables, summaries and screens (plan ch. 17).
Verified Purchase means the review is linked to a delivered order item recorded on Marketly. Only verified purchasers can review at launch; the label is still shown so the rule is explicit.
Legitimate negative reviews are never removed for being unfavourable: legitimate_experience can only keep, and harms_sales is accepted as a report reason but never as a removal reason.
Reporter and author both see the outcome (MyReport.outcome, MyReview.moderation); reporters are anonymous to authors.

Questions and answers are public and labelled Seller, Marketly staff or Customer. Only sellers with an offer on the product (offers, optional) can answer as seller; order-specific questions go to messaging.
Seller responses: one per review or feedback, public, rule-checked, editable for responseEditDays. A seller offering refunds or gifts to change a review is held and can be referred to trust.

Fake-review investigations belong to trust; reviews refers content (reviews.content.referred), removes content named in trust.enforcement.recorded (remove_reviews), keeps it for keep_reviews and reinstates it when trust reverses the enforcement (trust.enforcement.reversed). The decisions carry trustEnforcementId so trust confirms execution (decision D-R1).
The Official Store responds to reviews and feedback through admin (Official Store responses, permission reviews.answers.staff); responses show fromKind official_store and seller id OFFICIAL_STORE_ID.
Personal data: exportForCustomer supplies the Reviews section of the customer data export; customers.account.closed anonymises the author name on the customer's content.
Review invitations are stored in review_invites (decision D-R2), not kept in memory, so they survive restarts and are sent once.
Phase 2 brings stronger moderation (plan ch. 20): the queue already supports system flags and Trust and Risk referrals.
